reviews.t: This is the portable shower you’ve been looking for
reviews.x: I ordered this product looking for a wipe that I could use to clean myself up after a day outside- the sweat, mud, grime etc...Based on the recommendation of a friend I gave these a try. What I was expecting: a glorified baby wipe that was scented and I’d need to use a few to get kinda sorta clean. What I got: a wipe big and tough enough to get me totally freshened up by just using 1. Even the mud. Even the man stink. Oh, and it was hypoallergenic for my sensitive manly skin and unscented which

reviews.t: Sturdy full-body wipes, great for multi-day backpacking
reviews.x: This was my only form of a "bathing" during a recent 8-day climb up Mt. Kilimanjaro.  It did the trick, using one per day before bed.  I love that these are small and light weight.  They are plenty sturdy, just remember to start at the top of your body and work down (it's okay to wash your feet with the grim from your face, but not the other way around).  None tore and the smell is neutral (both things I worried about after using other products). I would highly recommend these wipes.

Picture camping in the PNW, just south of Mt. Bachelor. Humidity doesn’t exist and dust is everywhere. Once the kids leave the Airstream that’s it, they aren’t allowed back inside. Imagine PigPen but with feet like Frodo after walking to Mordor. They are filthy! “No, you can’t come back inside, you look like you just spent a weekend working with the Smoke Jumpers!”  This is where Venture Wipes have saved us. We can toss our grubby gremlins a wipe and before you know it, they resemble our sweet l

After reading all the reviews, I had high hopes for these... I went on a 10-day hunting trip out in the boonies in Michigan's U.P. Stayed at a cabin with no electricity or running water, so I figured these would be a good replacement for a shower.  They are very moist, was pleasantly surprised by that, but they failed to get rid of the stink. I typically use a natural tea-tree oil-based shower gel which is great for B.O. removal and since these were one of the few choices that contained TTO, I p
These have polyaminoproppyl biguanide which from my research can cause cancer and was banned in 2015

reviews.t: Best and Biggest body wipes ever used!
reviews.x: I was looking for something to use out on the boat that was small, easy and convenient to use. Well, this is it! I love the size of the towel and also, how conveniently small the package is to be able to store and keep them on the boat. We use them to wipe down at the end of a long day fishing getting the sunscreen and the salty water off! You will not be disappointed with this purchase! Would recommend them to anyone!

Great to have on hand when backpacking, camping, road tripping or in any situation where a shower might not be an option.  Wipes are large, durable and free from strong perfumes.  They do the trick.  While one might work for your entire body, I tend to use two so I'm not rubbing my own funk back into myself at the end of the process.

reviews.t: These really are big enough and they hold up to hard use.
reviews.x: Most wipes are like cheap toilet paper; prone to get holes. These are thick enough and tough enough. I am a big guy and they are big enough for me. When dry camping or camping in an RV in the winter when you are trying to eliminate or reduce water use these are great. They are not cheap but they are worth it. I recommend these highly.

My husband and I are full time travelers. We have tried just about every shower wipe out there and after a bit over 1 year, Venture Wipes are now the only ones we use for our shower wipes needs. They work very well, have a pleasant very mild essential oil smell and are soft enough for delicate skin while still being strong enough to scrub. They are smaller then some of the shower towel wipes but we have found 2 of the Venture Wipes are cheeper then 1 of the larger wipes and give you the option o
These are a perfect for our family when we boondock or don't have full hookups. I was surprised at how big they were, plus they smell much better than a baby wipe. HIGHLY RECOMMEND!

“Sailing the world” As a family living on a boat full-time! We have found that on long passages and short passages. Venture Wipes saves on water from the limited amount we have. One Adventure Wipe Reduces a long day at sea with all the salt spray and leaves us feeling refreshed while saving on the pressures thing called water! Also after scuba diving it works great I’m cleaning off gear without using precious water. I also use it in the engine room for cleaning things up it is an all-around must

reviews.t: Best option for a quick cleanup on the go - truly meant for the great outdoors
reviews.x: We absolutely love our Venture Wipes.  We stay at campgrounds and my son is always outside exploring the great outdoors.  These things are a lifesaver for a stinky, dirty, smelly boy at the end of a long day.  We also keep a small stash of them in our Jeep Wrangler Rubicon, as they are the perfect cleanup solution after a day of hitting the trails.

We do lots of dry camping where water is a limited commodity. So we were really excited to try out this product! It did not disappoint! The wipes are huge and while we did not use them for full body ‘showers’ I got all 4 kids and myself pretty clean with 2 wipes. We will definitely be return customers!

reviews.t: Great thick adult wipe for messy life.
reviews.x: Venture wipes is an outstanding product. I’m very impressed with the size, 12” x 12” and the substantial overall feel of this wipe. It’s nice and thick and has a very good texture that quickly removes all kinds of dirt and grime. Plus it has no sticky residual. Just a nice clean feeling left on your skin. Plus it’s hypoallergenic which is great for sensitive skin. I’ll be keeping these wipes in my Jeep, my pickup and will be using them whenever I don’t have access to water for washing up. Great

reviews.t: Finally found the perfect cleansing wipe :)
reviews.x: i've been trying out wipes for an upcoming trip...finally found these after 4 other brands.  these are great!  large, not too wet/not too dry - great textured surface.  and no heavy scent - just light and fresh.  no residue at all.  and if you do run out of moisture before you're done they are fine with a little warm water on them (but i doubt you will need to do this).  perfect for camping.

Bought these for a recent vintage camper rally and I can't say enough good things about this product. Perfect if you are boondocking or if you just don't want to use the showers at a campground especially during this time. Have several fellow campers ordering these after mentioning during campfire. So glad they came so fast just in time for my trip!

Leaves your skin fresh and clean without residue or scent.  Perfect texture and durable enough to get completely filthy without breaking apart.  This is the first kind I have used that are better than just a larger version of a baby wipe.  I clean the dogs paws with them too.

Purchased for camping but started to use them around the house after gardening, exercising, etc.  The wipes are medium size and for me, a 6'2" male they are sufficient to get most of the sweat etc., off.  Nice smell, great packaging, worth the cost to us.

I like these wipes! They are big and soft. They are refreshing and don't leave a sticky residue or lint like some other wipes. One wipe is plenty to do your face, pits, and naughty bits. I use them on my dog too and she seems to like it.

reviews.t: Just more single use, throw away stuff
reviews.x: This is just more single use, throw away stuff in plastic packets. Buy a few small microfiber towels, wash and re-use! https://www.amazon.com/Microfiber-Kitchen-Absorbent-Counters-Streak-Free/dp/B07D9XLKPH/
After a dusty weekend camping in Zion, these were a life saver! Large size, does not fall apart and zero scent. Will be purchasing again for every camping trip.
I used these when I was in a 3rd world country with no bathing facilities. I felt clean and fresh after use. I will use these again.
Scent is barely there..and I only recieved 6 not 12 but charhed the entire amount.
I had recent surgery and could not take a shower and these were perfect!

If you're looking for a backpacking wipe to clean the sweat and grime off at the end of the day before climbing into the tent for the night, these Venture Wipes are definitely the best on the market. They are adequately moist, alcohol-free, and more like a perforated or quilted towelette than a thin wet wipe..thick and heavy duty. At 12"x12" they have enough surface area to cleanse  most of your body. So unless you're taking a dip in a fresh stream, these are great for those water-scarce campsit

claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the wipes as large, thick, and durable enough for full-body use.
Many customers find them effective for camping, backpacking, boating, and other situations without access to a shower.
Several reviewers appreciate the mild or light scent and lack of sticky residue.
Some reviewers consider the product pricey, though they still find it worthwhile.
A few negative reviews raise concerns about a banned ingredient and unmet high expectations.
